name: School Life: Welcome Home
source:
You have a new school! Well, Not new. You went there for the past 2 years. However something is... off. Remember the words the Principal said? You can not escape. What does it mean? Find out.
[From [url=https://aideveloper.itch.io/school-life-welcome-home] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有一所新学校！嗯，不新鲜。过去两年你去过那里。然而有些东西……关闭了。还记得校长说过的话吗？你无法逃脱。这是什么意思？查出。
[来自[url=https://aideveloper.itch.io/school-life-welcome-home] itch.io[/url]]
